whoami

One engineer, three lenses on the same system.

I work where backend, platform, and reliability meet. At Maersk I build self-service GoLang APIs that automate infrastructure, then own them through CI/CD, observability, and the pager.

My home turf is Apache Kafka on Strimzi/Kubernetes — zero-downtime upgrades, org-wide schema governance, and clusters hardened end-to-end with TLS/mTLS and Vault. I care about the unglamorous parts that keep platforms trustworthy.

signature work

The migration that paid for itself.

★ Star Award · Q1 2023

Confluent → self-managed Apache Kafka, with nobody noticing.

Migrated a distributed streaming system from Confluent onto self-managed Apache Kafka on Strimzi/Kubernetes — exactly-once semantics preserved, zero data loss, zero critical incidents — then built the tooling that keeps it healthy.

Confluent Platform ⟶ Strimzi · Kubernetes = ↓15% cost · 0 data loss · 0 incidents
📊↓70% schema incidents

Schema Registry FULL-compatibility validation enforced via REST, org-wide.

🚀+10% DORA metrics

Pre-runtime checks in GitHub Actions + FluxCD, with zero-downtime rollouts.

🔍+15% data visibility

KafkaUI component on OpenMetadata for discovery & lineage.
